description: End-to-end LPWAN (LoRaWAN/NB-IoT) performance and incident management workflow for TaaS IoT, from monitoring metrics to diagnosing, mitigating, and resolving performance issues.

tenant_id.description: Identifier of the tenant/account in the TaaS platform.

network_id.description: Logical LPWAN network identifier (e.g., LoRaWAN network or NB-IoT slice).

gateway_id.description: Unique identifier of an LPWAN gateway.

device_id.description: Unique identifier of an IoT end device (e.g., DevEUI or IMEI).

policy_id.description: Identifier for a performance or QoS policy.

remediation_plan_id.description: Identifier of a remediation plan created to mitigate performance issues.

correlation_id.description: Identifier used to correlate multi-step diagnostics or remediation operations.

functions.name: define_performance_policy
functions.description: Create or update a performance policy defining thresholds, KPIs, and scopes for LPWAN monitoring.

tenant_id.description: Tenant to which this policy belongs.

policy_id.description: Existing policy ID to update. If omitted, a new policy is created.

description.description: Detailed description of the policy's intent.

scope.description: Defines what the policy applies to.

level.description: Primary scope level for the policy.

network_ids.description: Specific networks this policy applies to; empty means all networks of tenant.

gateway_ids.description: Gateways to which this policy applies when level is gateway or device.

device_ids.description: Devices this policy applies to (if level is device).

device_tags.description: Device tags used to dynamically select devices.

kpis.description: List of KPIs and thresholds to monitor.

notification_rules.description: How and where to send alerts when thresholds are violated.

recipients.description: Recipient identifiers (emails, phone numbers, webhook URLs, or Slack channels).

cooldown_minutes.description: Minimum minutes between repeated notifications for the same condition.

functions.returns: Created or updated performance policy with policy_id and effective scope.

functions.name: list_performance_policies
functions.description: List and filter performance policies for a tenant.

search.description: Free text search over policy name and description.

functions.returns: Paginated list of performance policies including basic metadata and scope summaries.

functions.name: get_performance_snapshot
functions.description: Retrieve aggregated performance metrics snapshot for a network, gateway, or device over a time window.

target.description: Entity whose performance is being queried.

metrics.description: List of metric types to include; if empty, includes all standard metrics.

functions.returns: Aggregated metrics snapshot with values, groupings, and time bucket information.

functions.name: get_metric_timeseries
functions.description: Fetch detailed time series for selected KPIs for analysis and visualization.

entity.description: Single entity for which to query time series.

resolution.description: Sampling interval for the time series.

downsample.description: Optional downsampling configuration for large time ranges.

max_points.description: Maximum number of data points to return per KPI.

functions.returns: Time series data for requested KPIs with timestamps and values per KPI.

functions.name: detect_performance_anomalies
functions.description: Run anomaly detection for selected entities and KPIs, optionally using advanced algorithms.

correlation_id.description: Client-provided ID to correlate follow-up diagnostic actions.

functions.returns: List of detected anomalies with impacted entities, KPIs, severity, and a correlation_id for downstream diagnostics.

functions.name: create_performance_alert
functions.description: Create a performance alert/incident manually or from detected anomalies and attach relevant context.

trigger_details.description: Information about what caused the alert.

auto_assign.description: Whether to auto-assign alert to an on-call engineer based on routing rules.

functions.returns: Created alert record with alert_id, current status, and assignment details.

functions.name: get_alert_details
functions.description: Retrieve full details of a specific performance alert, including history and related entities.
functions.returns: Comprehensive alert details including status, timeline, comments, related alerts, and any associated remediation plans.

functions.name: run_root_cause_diagnosis
functions.description: Execute automated diagnostics to identify probable root causes for a performance alert or anomaly.

alert_id.description: Alert to diagnose. Optional if correlation_id is provided.

correlation_id.description: Correlation ID referencing previously detected anomalies.

functions.returns: Diagnosis report with probable root causes, confidence scores, impacted components, and suggested remediation actions, along with a correlation_id for tracking.

functions.name: propose_remediation_plan
functions.description: Generate a remediation plan with ordered actions based on diagnosis results.

constraints.description: Operational constraints for the remediation plan.

allowed_actions.description: Whitelist of action types that can be included.

functions.returns: Draft remediation plan with remediation_plan_id, list of proposed actions, dependencies, and estimated impact and risk scores.

functions.name: execute_remediation_plan
functions.description: Execute or schedule execution of a remediation plan, with dry-run and partial execution support.

action_overrides.description: Override settings for individual actions in the plan.

rollback_on_failure.description: Whether to automatically rollback if a critical step fails.

correlation_id.description: Correlation ID for linking execution with alert and diagnosis.

functions.returns: Execution status with correlation_id, per-action execution results (or simulation results for dry_run), and any scheduled job ID for future runs.

functions.name: rollback_remediation
functions.description: Rollback configuration changes made by a specific remediation execution.

correlation_id.description: Correlation ID from execute_remediation_plan to identify what to rollback.

actions_to_rollback.description: Required when rollback_scope is partial; list of specific action IDs to rollback.

force.description: If true, attempt rollback even if consistency checks fail.

functions.returns: Rollback job result with summary of reverted changes, any failures, and updated configuration baselines.

functions.name: update_alert_status
functions.description: Update the lifecycle status of a performance alert and optionally attach resolution notes.

verification_metrics.description: Metrics used to verify that the issue was resolved.

comment.description: Additional operator comment to record in alert history.

functions.returns: Updated alert with new status, assignment, and appended history entry.

functions.name: check_post_mitigation_performance
functions.description: Validate performance after remediation by comparing key KPIs before and after the change.

correlation_id.description: Correlation ID of the remediation execution.

entities.description: Entities to verify; if omitted, uses impacted entities from remediation plan.

baseline_window.description: Time window before remediation as baseline.

post_window.description: Time window after remediation to evaluate improvements.

success_criteria.description: Optional explicit success criteria per KPI.

target_value.description: Target KPI value or improvement amount depending on improvement_type.

functions.returns: Verification report comparing baseline and post-mitigation KPI values, indicating pass/fail per KPI and overall remediation effectiveness.

functions.name: bulk_import_performance_alerts
functions.description: Bulk-import multiple performance_alerts from an upstream source with validation and idempotency keys.

mapping.description: Field mapping from source to canonical schema

functions.returns: A bulk-import job descriptor with counts of accepted, rejected, and quarantined performance_alerts, plus a job_id for follow-up.

functions.name: bulk_update_performance_alerts
functions.description: Apply a partial update to a batch of performance_alerts matched by filter or id list.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

patch.description: Fields to patch on each matched item

functions.returns: Summary of matched, updated, and skipped performance_alerts with per-item error details.

functions.name: bulk_archive_performance_alerts
functions.description: Archive (soft-delete) a batch of performance_alerts with retention metadata and audit reasons.
functions.returns: Per-id archive results with new lifecycle state.

functions.name: bulk_export_performance_alerts
functions.description: Export a filtered set of performance_alerts to a downstream destination (S3, GCS, blob, SFTP).

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Export job handle including job_id, expected object URIs, row count, and signed download URLs when applicable.

functions.name: search_performance_alerts_advanced
functions.description: Advanced faceted search across performance_alerts with full-text, structured filters, aggregations, and sort.

query.description: Full-text query string with Lucene-like syntax

functions.returns: Search response with performance_alerts hits, total count, aggregation buckets, and a next-cursor.

functions.name: create_performance_alert_subscription
functions.description: Create a subscription that fires webhooks or notifications on performance_alert lifecycle events.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: The created subscription including subscription_id, active state, and last_delivery info (initially null).

functions.name: list_performance_alert_subscriptions
functions.description: List existing performance_alert subscriptions with optional filters and pagination.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated list of subscription objects including delivery health stats.

functions.name: deactivate_performance_alert_subscription
functions.description: Deactivate or delete a performance_alert subscription and optionally flush pending deliveries.
functions.returns: Updated subscription state and the number of pending deliveries flushed or kept.

functions.name: get_performance_alert_audit_log
functions.description: Return the audit/change log for a single performance_alert with field-level diffs and actor info.

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Chronological list of audit events with before/after diffs, actor, and source IP/system.

functions.name: search_audit_events
functions.description: Search audit events across performance_alerts for compliance and forensic review.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated audit-event hits with cross-entity references.

functions.name: schedule_performance_alert_job
functions.description: Create a recurring schedule that triggers a named operation on a target set of performance_alerts.

operation.description: Named operation to invoke (e.g., refresh, recompute, export, reconcile)

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: The created scheduled-job descriptor with job_id, next_run_at, and current status.

functions.name: list_performance_alert_jobs
functions.description: List scheduled or in-flight jobs related to performance_alerts with status filtering and pagination.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated list of performance_alert jobs and their last run summaries.

functions.name: cancel_performance_alert_job
functions.description: Cancel a scheduled or in-flight performance_alert job, optionally interrupting running steps.
functions.returns: Updated job status with cancellation timestamp and any side effects.

functions.name: simulate_performance_alert_change
functions.description: Simulate a proposed change against a performance_alert (or batch) without committing; returns expected diffs and warnings.
functions.returns: Simulation result with predicted diffs, rule violations, cost/SLA impact, and a confidence score.

functions.name: request_performance_alert_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a sensitive performance_alert change requiring reviewer sign-off.
functions.returns: Created approval request with approval_request_id, current state, and notification targets.

functions.name: submit_performance_alert_approval_decision
functions.description: Submit an approve, reject, or request-changes decision against a performance_alert approval request.
functions.returns: Updated approval request state including quorum progress and final decision (if reached).

functions.name: add_performance_alert_comment
functions.description: Append a comment or annotation to a performance_alert, optionally attaching files or mentioning users.
functions.returns: The created comment object with comment_id, timestamps, and visibility-resolved permissions.

functions.name: list_performance_alert_comments
functions.description: List comments and annotations attached to a performance_alert, with optional thread expansion.
functions.returns: Paginated comment list with thread tree and attachment metadata.

functions.name: snapshot_performance_alert
functions.description: Create a point-in-time immutable snapshot of a performance_alert for forensic, rollback, or compliance use.
functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor with snapshot_id, checksum, byte size, and retention expiry.

functions.name: restore_performance_alert_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a performance_alert from a previously created snapshot, optionally as a new copy.
functions.returns: Restore job descriptor including resulting id and any per-field conflicts that were resolved.

functions.name: get_performance_alert_metrics
functions.description: Compute KPI metrics over performance_alerts (counts, MTTR, SLA compliance, error rates) for a time window.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Time-bucketed metric series and aggregate KPIs for the matched performance_alerts.

functions.name: build_performance_alert_dashboard
functions.description: Persist a named dashboard composed of widgets (charts, tables, single-stat) over performance_alerts data.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Created dashboard descriptor with dashboard_id, shareable URL, and computed first-render preview.

functions.name: upsert_performance_alert_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule used to govern performance_alert behavior, validation, or routing.
functions.returns: Persisted policy with policy_id, version, rule count, and validation warnings (if any).

functions.name: list_performance_alert_policies
functions.description: List policies governing performance_alerts with version, scope, and lifecycle filters.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated policy entries with rule counts and last evaluation metrics.

functions.name: link_performance_alert_dependencies
functions.description: Establish or update dependency links between a performance_alert and related artefacts.
functions.returns: Updated dependency graph summary with added/removed/updated edges.
